issues.description: The online PR still points to 19a2102031 and its otherwise template-conformant body contains the superseded 25/76 test accounting and old W3/W4 hashes. This is expected before the final branch push, but the same PR body must be updated to 52/52 names, 76/76 comparisons, 230 total points, W3 log 24a114d1..., and this audit's final commit before review or CI evidence is accepted.

summary.result: PASS: the current upstream/main...HEAD diff has no P0, P1, or P2 findings. The complete upstream suite is directly evidenced as 52 unique names and 76 matching executions with zero failures; test-only fixtures remain outside the public dependency surface; all three patches apply with patch-ng fuzz disabled; W3 and both failure-atomicity test layers are internally consistent. One non-blocking P3 records the required online PR synchronization after the final push.

diff_scope.atomicity: One cvm/0.97 archive, its software-level metadata, reports, and one paired Path-B knowledge draft. No framework, CI, index, summary, foreign archive, runtime state, log, cache, or binary artifact is tracked.

worktree_binding.detail: Before writing this report the tracked worktree was clean at 056886eee0adc9cc6152588d76486c59c228c1b2; all 23 audited paths are hashed below. This report is the only file written by the auditor.

entries.detail: The zero-context Makefile hunk is accepted by patch-ng without fuzz and W3 independently records its application before the complete build and test pass.

upstream_test_accounting.detail: The original tests.sh contains exactly 76 literal run_compare_test calls naming 52 unique tests. The W3 execution block contains exactly 76 Running test records with the same ordered name sequence, including SQLite, Qmail/vmailmgr, AF_UNIX local, and UDP lifecycle cases.

af_unix_fixture_mount.detail: The recipe does not assume that /storage or /data supports pathname AF_UNIX. It creates a per-process directory, performs a real AF_UNIX SOCK_STREAM bind, records errno for rejected candidates, cleans failed probes, and only passes the successful directory to the upstream suite. W3 selected /data/storage/el2/base/cache and all local transport cases passed.

path_b_evidence.scope: Failure-atomic staged acquisition of multiple IPC resources before fork or another irreversible side effect
deterministic_scenarios: first pipe failure: no second pipe, fork, or close
second pipe failure: no fork; descriptors 10 and 11 closed exactly once
fork failure: descriptors 20, 21, 10, and 11 closed in reverse acquisition order
parent success: only descriptors 10 and 21 closed; 11 and 20 transferred
path_b_evidence.revert_sensitivity: Restoring the upstream == -2 condition makes the same matrix fail deterministically with exit code 2 before the normal side-effect contract can pass.

path_b_evidence.knowledge_boundary: The draft explicitly excludes SPAC cross-toolchain generation, Libtool relocation/signing, and OHOS storage diagnostics as existing knowledge, and supplies fixed-commit Git/OpenSSH cross-project examples plus an applicability boundary.
